list.item: Low mood, sleeplessness (about four hours a night), poor appetite, and unintended loss of 3.5 kg (6 percent) over three months, after bereavements and in a demanding public role; under evaluation for depression and medical causes: active, confirmed [S]
Partial loss of teeth with an ill-fitting upper partial denture and painful chewing, contributing to poor intake: active, confirmed [S]
One fall in the past year (a stumble boarding a boat, with bruised shins) and low body weight; fall risk: active, confirmed [S]

Workup for medical causes of low mood and weight loss: blood count, metabolic panel, calcium, albumin, TSH, vitamin B12, and folate; MoCA cognitive screen; medication review (stop the over-the-counter diphenhydramine sleep aid); dental examination; age-appropriate cancer screening confirmed up to date. Guideline: APA Clinical Practice Guideline for the Treatment of Depression Across Three Age Cohorts (2019); VA/DoD Clinical Practice Guideline for the Management of Major Depressive Disorder (2022); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, depression, bipolar, and mood disorders monograph (2026); American Geriatrics Society 2023 Updated AGS Beers Criteria for Potentially Inappropriate Medication Use in Older Adults (2023) [S]

Suicide-risk assessment and collaborative safety plan: warning signs, coping steps, people to contact, the clinic number, and the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline; medicines kept by her maid; safety reviewed at every visit. Guideline: VA/DoD Clinical Practice Guideline for Assessment and Management of Patients at Risk for Suicide (2024); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, depression, bipolar, and mood disorders monograph (2026) [S]

Geriatric psychiatry consultation to confirm the diagnosis, review grief, cognition, and safety, and advise on antidepressant choice and psychotherapy for an older adult. Guideline: APA Clinical Practice Guideline for the Treatment of Depression Across Three Age Cohorts (2019); VA/DoD Clinical Practice Guideline for the Management of Major Depressive Disorder (2022); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, depression, bipolar, and mood disorders monograph (2026) [S]

Sleep: stop diphenhydramine; cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia (sleep window, stimulus control, a fixed rising time, no long naps, and worry time early in the evening); no benzodiazepines, Z-drugs, or sedating antihistamines. Guideline: American Geriatrics Society 2023 Updated AGS Beers Criteria for Potentially Inappropriate Medication Use in Older Adults (2023); Management of Chronic Insomnia Disorder in Adults: A Clinical Practice Guideline From the American College of Physicians (2016) [S]

Nutrition: three small meals and two snacks a day, an oral nutrition supplement twice a day, weight at every visit, and a dental review for the painful partial denture. Guideline: APA Clinical Practice Guideline for the Treatment of Depression Across Three Age Cohorts (2019); VA/DoD Clinical Practice Guideline for the Management of Major Depressive Disorder (2022); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, depression, bipolar, and mood disorders monograph (2026) [S]

Falls: Timed Up and Go and orthostatic blood pressure now and again if an antidepressant is started, since SSRIs raise fall risk in older adults; home safety review with her staff; an exercise class for balance and strength. Guideline: American Geriatrics Society 2023 Updated AGS Beers Criteria for Potentially Inappropriate Medication Use in Older Adults (2023); Falls Prevention in Community-Dwelling Older Adults: Interventions (2024) [S]

Measurement-based care: PHQ-9 at every visit and at least monthly and GDS-15 monthly; if an SSRI is started, a sodium check two to four weeks later; continue any treatment that works for at least six to twelve months after remission. Guideline: APA Clinical Practice Guideline for the Treatment of Depression Across Three Age Cohorts (2019); VA/DoD Clinical Practice Guideline for the Management of Major Depressive Disorder (2022); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, depression, bipolar, and mood disorders monograph (2026); American Geriatrics Society 2023 Updated AGS Beers Criteria for Potentially Inappropriate Medication Use in Older Adults (2023) [S]

Privacy: chart access restricted to her care team, appointments at the end of the clinic day, results given in person, and nothing released without her written consent. Guideline: APA Clinical Practice Guideline for the Treatment of Depression Across Three Age Cohorts (2019); VA/DoD Clinical Practice Guideline for the Management of Major Depressive Disorder (2022); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, depression, bipolar, and mood disorders monograph (2026) [S]
